Class XmlUtils

java.lang.Object
org.apache.rat.testhelpers.XmlUtils

Utilities to help test XML documents.

    • getNodeList

      public static NodeList getNodeList(Object source, XPath xPath, String xpath) throws XPathExpressionException
      Gets a Nodelist from an XPath string.
      Parameters:
      source - the context for the XPath statement to be evaluated in. See XPathExpression.evaluate(Object, QName).
      xPath - the XPath object to compile the statement with.
      xpath - the XPath statement to compile.
      Returns:
      the NodeList of nodes that matches the XPath.
      Throws:
      XPathExpressionException - on error.

    • isPresent

      public static boolean isPresent(Object source, XPath xPath, String xpath) throws XPathExpressionException
      Determines whether an XPath identified a node in the source.
      Parameters:
      source - the context for the XPath statement to be evaluated in. See XPathExpression.evaluate(Object, QName).
      xPath - the XPath object to compile the statement with.
      xpath - the XPath statement to compile.
      Returns:
      true if the document contains the node identified by the XPath statement, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      XPathExpressionException - on error.

      public static Node getNode(Object source, XPath xPath, String xpath) throws XPathExpressionException
